decisions.reason: The pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management know-how, so its own R&D can readily interpret field results and refine the system.
The cleaning centrifuge builds directly on the firm's filtration expertise, giving it strong absorptive capacity to learn from early use and improve the product.
Coolant nozzles are a simple complementary component within the firm's established coolant systems, cheap to maintain and easy to improve from existing knowledge.
Scraper belt chip conveyors sit at the heart of the firm's conveying competence, so feedback is easily assimilated and the product fits its modular portfolio.
The magnetic belt conveyor applies the firm's proven conveying technology to a related niche, and its engineering base allows quick learning and adaptation.
The hinged belt conveyor is closely tied to the firm's established chip conveying offer, making it a low-risk, well-understood addition worth keeping.
